title: Chigaro Choumambo Chakafamba Pakarepo
intro: Munhu ane simba guru akatonga umambo hwakapfuma hwakanga hwakaropafadzwa nepfuma isingaperi. Pakamuka dambudziko risingatarisirwi, mutongi uyu akatarisana nemuedzo kwete weminondo asi weuchenjeri nekutenda. Zvakazoitika zvaizotungamira kubva pakakwirira pesimba renyika kusvika pakushanduka kukuru kwemoyo.
clues: Ndakatonga umambo hwakakomborerwa nepfuma nekubudirira kusingafungidzirwi
Ndakanga ndiri mambo ane simba akagamuchira tsamba yakasimba ichida kuzviisa pasi
Madzishe angu akandipa zano rekuti ndorwa here kana kuti ndoita rugare namambo uyu ari kure.
Ndakaenda nezvipo zvakanaka kwazvo kuti ndinosangana namambo uyu ari kure ini pachangu
Chigaro changu choumambo chakauyiswa kunyika iri kure nekukuruma kweziso, ndisati ndadzoka
Pandakapinda mumuzinda waive pasi rakatsetseka segirazi, ndakazopedzisira ndazivisa kuzviisa kwangu kuna Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
